batch: Public batch entry points call certify_candidate_with_config and then the private replay_from_certification; they do not accept an externally supplied residual-ball report.
removal_search: Removal search reruns scalar certification from problem/context through diagnose_failed_constraints_with_config. Existing-report diagnosis remains covered by the packaged corpus.
scope: Source-path review only. No new batch/removal runtime execution or global consumer closure claim. No production edits or inventory additions.
